jobs.title: Angular Software Engineer
jobs.description:
#Innovation and Technology #Permanent Position #International Mind-set #Challenging Projects

Fincons Group is an IT business consulting company that has been designing the digital future of leading companies on international markets for 40 years. Fincons Group built its reputation on foreseeing and interpreting new business models and the rapid evolution of IT systems by building a complete range of services: from research and consulting to design and development, from system integration of leading vendor software solutions right up to application management, supporting clients step by step along their digital transformation journey. Fincons is a multinational with over 2,600 people and several offices worldwide (in Italy, Switzerland, Germany, France, the United Kingdom, Belgium and the USA), but above all a Family Company where the founders play a strategic role with commitment and passion, grounding the company in the same principles of a united and caring family.

We firmly believe in the value of cooperation and in the contribution that every idea and intuition can bring. We believe that everyone’s effort can make a difference. Transforming knowledge into a strategic resource is our company mission, and we pursue it with the help of our most strategic asset: our people.

We are looking for a passionate Software Engineer with strong Front-End expertise and hands-on experience on Angular/Typescript, eager to contribute to modern, scalable, and high-performing web applications in an international environment.

Responsibilities and Duties

- Shape the right solutions and technologies for the customer
- Closely collaborate with the customer and other team members
- Design, develop, and maintain thought-out solutions
- Work together to improve and optimize existing functionalities
- Stay updated on new technologies and patterns

Qualifications and Skills

- Bachelor's/Master's degree in computer science, related disciplines, or equivalent experience
- Solid hands-on experience with Angular (version 19 or higher), and advanced knowledge of Typescript
- Strong command of HTML5, CSS
- Experience building responsive, modular, and maintainable front-end architectures
- Familiarity with CI/CD environments and DevOps best practices (Docker, Jenkins, OpenShift)
- Exposure to Java and Spring Boot is appreciated, as it supports effective collaboration with backend teams and helps in understanding the services and APIs underpinning the application
- Fluent in English and Italian is needed to work in our international environment

Location and Work Flexibility

- Please note that a fully remote work policy is not offered for this role
- Candidates should be prepared to relocate to Canton Ticino (Switzerland) or to Italian border areas close to Switzerland
- Work-from-home days may be possible according to the Client's policy

Our personnel search is addressed to candidates of all genders.

The data will be processed and stored exclusively for the purposes of this or future selections, in compliance with the Federal Data Protection Law (LPD) and guaranteeing the rights referred to in art. 13 Legislative Decree 196/03 and EU regulation 679/2016 (GDPR)

jobs.description:
Fincons Group is an IT business consulting company that has been designing the digital future of leading companies on international markets for 40 years. Fincons Group built its reputation on foreseeing and interpreting new business models and the rapid evolution of IT systems by building a complete range of services: from research and consulting to design and development, from system integration of leading vendor software solutions right up to application management, supporting clients step by step along their digital transformation journey. Fincons is a multinational with over 2,600 people and several offices worldwide (in Italy, Switzerland, Germany, France, the United Kingdom, Belgium and the USA), but above all a Family Company where the founders play a strategic role with commitment and passion, grounding the company in the same principles of a united and caring family.

We firmly believe in the value of cooperation and in the contribution that every idea and intuition can bring. We believe that everyone’s effort can make a difference. Transforming knowledge into a strategic resource is our company's mission, and we pursue it with the help of our most strategic asset: our people.

## Job Overview

For our Lugano Branch (TI), we are looking for a C orporate PMO / Business Operations Expert to support the DACH General Manager and the regional Business in driving internal operations, governance, and business performance.

Responsibilities and Duties

Executive, Governance & Commercial Support

- Support the DACH General Manager in daily operations and strategic activities
- Prepare dashboards and reports for Top Management and C-level stakeholders
- Support the organization of Steering Committees, Management Meetings and Townhalls
- Maintain and update corporate presentations and institutional materials
- Support market analysis and alignment with Account teams
- Monitor upselling, cross-selling initiatives and pipeline performance
- Manage company references and client portfolio
- Support contract lifecycle (initial review, DocuSign, archiving)
- Collect and consolidate resource and budget inputs from DACH Accounts

Tender & Bid Management

- Support feasibility assessment and planning for tenders and mini-tenders
- Coordinate internal stakeholders in proposal preparation and tender presentation
- Collect and manage required documentation
- Manage client procurement portals (submissions, questionnaires, registrations)

Qualifications & Skills

- Degree in Management Engineering, Business Administration, or related fields
- 2–5 years of experience as PMO or in Business Operations within IT Consulting
- Strong stakeholder management skills (including C-level exposure)
- Excellent organizational and problem-solving skills
- Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities and stakeholders
- Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills
- Fluency in English and Italian; German is a plus

If interested, please apply here !

titleByLocale.it: PMO aziendale / Esperto di Operazioni Aziendali

descriptionByLocale.it: Fincons Group è una società di consulenza aziendale informatica che da 40 anni progetta il futuro digitale di aziende leader sui mercati internazionali. Fincons Group ha costruito la propria reputazione prevedendo e interpretando nuovi modelli di business e la rapida evoluzione dei sistemi IT costruendo una gamma completa di servizi: dalla ricerca e consulenza alla progettazione e sviluppo, dall'integrazione di sistemi di soluzioni software dei principali fornitori fino alla gestione delle applicazioni, supportando i clienti passo dopo passo nel loro percorso di trasformazione digitale. Fincons è una multinazionale con oltre 2.600 persone e diverse sedi nel mondo (in Italia, Svizzera, Germania, Francia, Regno Unito, Belgio e USA), ma soprattutto un'azienda familiare dove i fondatori svolgono un ruolo strategico con impegno e passione, radicando l'azienda sugli stessi principi di una famiglia unita e premurosa. Crediamo fermamente nel valore della cooperazione e nel contributo che ogni idea e intuizione può portare. Crediamo che lo sforzo di tutti possa fare la differenza. Trasformare la conoscenza in una risorsa strategica è la missione della nostra azienda, e la perseguiamo con l'ausilio del nostro asset più strategico: le nostre persone. Panoramica del lavoro: per la nostra filiale di Lugano (TI), stiamo cercando un PMO aziendale/esperto di operazioni aziendali per supportare il direttore generale di DACH e l'azienda regionale nella guida delle operazioni interne, della governance e delle prestazioni aziendali. Ruoli e responsabilità Supporto esecutivo, governance e commerciale - Supportare il direttore generale DACH nelle operazioni quotidiane e nelle attività strategiche - Preparare dashboard e report per il top management e le parti interessate di livello C - Supportare l'organizzazione di comitati direttivi, riunioni di gestione e municipi - Mantenere e aggiornare presentazioni aziendali e materiali istituzionali - Supportare l'analisi di mercato e l'allineamento con i team account - Monitorare le iniziative di upselling, cross-selling e le prestazioni della pipeline - Gestire le referenze aziendali e il portafoglio clienti - Supportare il ciclo di vita del contratto (revisione iniziale, DocuSign, archiviazione) - Raccogliere e consolidare gli input di risorse e budget dagli account DACH Gestione gare d'appalto e offerte - Supportare la valutazione di fattibilità e la pianificazione di gare d'appalto e mini-gare - Coordinare le parti interessate interne nella preparazione delle proposte e nella presentazione delle offerte - Raccogliere e gestire la documentazione richiesta - Gestire i portali di appalto dei clienti (presentazioni, questionari, registrazioni) Qualifiche e competenze tecniche - Laurea in informatica, ingegneria informatica, sicurezza informatica o un campo correlato - Esperienza precedente nella sicurezza informatica/sicurezza informatica - Buona conoscenza delle architetture IT e dei sistemi informativi - Esperienza o familiarità con Attività GRC - Conoscenza dei principali framework e standard di sicurezza (ad esempio ISO 27001, NIST, DORA) - Comprensione della gestione del rischio e dei principi di conformità - Capacità di interagire con stakeholder sia tecnici che aziendali - Buona padronanza dell'inglese È utile avere - Laurea in ingegneria gestionale, amministrazione aziendale o campi correlati - 2-5 anni di esperienza come PMO o in operazioni aziendali nell'ambito della consulenza IT - Forti capacità di gestione degli stakeholder (inclusa l'esposizione a livello dirigenziale) - Eccellenti capacità organizzative e di risoluzione dei problemi - Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e gestire molteplici priorità e stakeholder - Competenze avanzate di Excel e PowerPoint - Ottima conoscenza dell'inglese e dell'italiano; Il tedesco è un vantaggio. Requisito di ubicazione - Non offriamo una politica di lavoro completamente a distanza - I candidati devono essere pronti a trasferirsi nel Canton Ticino (Svizzera) o in città di confine italiane (come Como, Varese ecc.) - I giorni di lavoro da casa potrebbero essere possibili secondo la politica Fincons Se interessati, si prega di fare domanda qui! La nostra ricerca di personale è rivolta a candidati di ogni genere. I dati saranno trattati e conservati esclusivamente per le finalità di questa o di future selezioni, nel rispetto della Legge Federale sulla Protezione dei Dati (LPD) e garantendo i diritti di cui all'art. 13 D.Lgs 196/03 e regolamento UE 679/2016 (GDPR).

descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Fincons Group ist ein IT-Business-Beratungsunternehmen, das seit 40 Jahren die digitale Zukunft führender Unternehmen auf internationalen Märkten gestaltet. Die Fincons Group baute ihren Ruf auf der Vorhersage und Interpretation neuer Geschäftsmodelle und der schnellen Entwicklung von IT-Systemen auf, indem sie ein komplettes Dienstleistungsspektrum aufbaute: von Forschung und Beratung über Design und Entwicklung, von der Systemintegration führender Anbieter von Softwarelösungen bis hin zum Anwendungsmanagement und unterstützt Kunden Schritt für Schritt auf ihrem Weg zur digitalen Transformation. Fincons ist ein multinationales Unternehmen mit über 2.600 Mitarbeitern und mehreren Niederlassungen weltweit (in Italien, der Schweiz, Deutschland, Frankreich, dem Vereinigten Königreich, Belgien und den USA), aber vor allem ein Familienunternehmen, in dem die Gründer mit Engagement und Leidenschaft eine strategische Rolle spielen und das Unternehmen auf den gleichen Prinzipien einer vereinten und fürsorglichen Familie gründen. Wir glauben fest an den Wert der Zusammenarbeit und an den Beitrag, den jede Idee und Intuition leisten kann. Wir glauben, dass der Einsatz jedes Einzelnen einen Unterschied machen kann. Wissen in eine strategische Ressource umzuwandeln, ist die Mission unseres Unternehmens, und wir verfolgen sie mit Hilfe unseres strategischsten Kapitals: unseren Mitarbeitern. Stellenübersicht: Für unsere Niederlassung in Lugano (TI) suchen wir einen Corporate PMO/Business Operations-Experten, der den DACH-General Manager und das regionale Geschäft bei der Förderung interner Abläufe, Governance und Geschäftsleistung unterstützt. Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten: Führungskraft, Governance und kaufmännische Unterstützung – Unterstützung des DACH-General Managers im täglichen Betrieb und bei strategischen Aktivitäten – Erstellung von Dashboards und Berichten für Top-Management- und C-Level-Stakeholder – Unterstützung bei der Organisation von Lenkungsausschüssen, Management-Meetings und Townhalls – Pflege und Aktualisierung von Unternehmenspräsentationen und institutionellen Materialien – Unterstützung von Marktanalysen und Abstimmung mit Account-Teams – Überwachung von Upselling-, Cross-Selling-Initiativen und Pipeline-Leistung – Verwaltung von Unternehmensreferenzen und Kundenportfolio – Unterstützung des Vertragslebenszyklus (erste Überprüfung, DocuSign, Archivierung) – Sammeln und Konsolidieren von Ressourcen- und Budgeteingaben aus DACH-Konten, Ausschreibungs- und Angebotsmanagement – Unterstützung der Machbarkeitsbewertung und Planung für Ausschreibungen und Mini-Ausschreibungen – Koordinierung interner Stakeholder bei der Angebotserstellung und Angebotspräsentation – Sammeln und Verwalten der erforderlichen Dokumentation – Verwalten von Kundenbeschaffungsportalen (Einreichungen, Fragebögen, Registrierungen) Qualifikationen und technische Fähigkeiten – Abschluss in Informatik, Computertechnik, Cybersicherheit oder einem verwandten Bereich – Vorherige Erfahrung in Informationssicherheit/Cybersicherheit – Gutes Verständnis von IT-Architekturen und Informationssystemen – Erfahrung oder Vertrautheit mit GRC-Aktivitäten – Kenntnisse der wichtigsten Sicherheitsrahmen und -standards (z. B. ISO 27001, NIST, DORA) – Verständnis der Risikomanagement- und Compliance-Grundsätze – Fähigkeit zur Interaktion mit technischen und geschäftlichen Stakeholdern – Gute Englischkenntnisse „Nice to Have“ – Abschluss in Management Engineering, Betriebswirtschaft oder verwandten Bereichen – 2–5 Jahre Erfahrung als PMO oder im Geschäftsbetrieb innerhalb der IT-Beratung – Starke Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten (einschließlich Kontakt auf C-Ebene) – Ausgezeichnete Organisations- und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten – Fähigkeit unabhängig zu arbeiten und mehrere Prioritäten und Interessengruppen zu verwalten – Fortgeschrittene Excel- und PowerPoint-Kenntnisse – Fließende Englisch- und Italienischkenntnisse; Deutsch ist ein Plus. • Wir bieten keine Richtlinie für die vollständige Fernarbeit an. – Kandidaten sollten bereit sein, in den Kanton Tessin (Schweiz) oder in italienische Grenzstädte (wie Como, Varese usw.) zu ziehen. – Tage, an denen Sie von zu Hause aus arbeiten können, können gemäß den Richtlinien von Fincons möglich sein. Fincons Group is an IT business consulting company that has been designing the digital future of leading companies on international markets for 40 years. Fincons Group built its reputation on foreseeing and interpreting new business models and the rapid evolution of IT systems by building a complete range of services: from research and consulting to design and development, from system integration of leading vendor software solutions right up to application management, supporting clients step by step along their digital transformation journey. Fincons is a multinational with over 2,600 people and several offices worldwide (in Italy, Switzerland, Germany, France, the United Kingdom, Belgium and the USA), but above all a Family Company where the founders play a strategic role with commitment and passion, grounding the company in the same principles of a united and caring family.

We firmly believe in the value of cooperation and in the contribution that every idea and intuition can bring. We believe that everyone’s effort can make a difference. Transforming knowledge into a strategic resource is our company mission, and we pursue it with the help of our most strategic asset: our people.

For our Lugano Branch we are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer Java/React to be part of our team.

Responsibilities and Duties

- Drive the continuous improvement and optimization of existing features, ensuring an exceptional user experience
- Deliver high-quality, maintainable, and performant code, following best practices and modern development standards
- Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve bugs and performance issues across the stack
- Develop and integrate RESTful APIs and ensure smooth communication between frontend and backend systems
- Contribute to a collaborative Agile environment by mentoring peers, sharing knowledge, and supporting team success across an international context

Qualifications and Skills

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related scientific field
- Minimum 5 years of proven experience in software development within structured and complex environments
- Solid experience in backend development with Java (e.g. Spring / Spring Boot is a plus)
- Strong hands-on experience in frontend development using React.js
- Strong understanding of UI/UX principles and ability to build intuitive, user-centric interfaces
- Good knowledge of Redux for state management
- Experience with DevOps practices and tools (e.g. CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, cloud platforms) is considered a strong plus
- Familiarity with REST APIs, system integration, and full-stack architecture
- Experience with version control systems (e.g. Git) and collaborative development workflows
- Fluent in English, both written and spoken (mandatory)

Location and Work Flexibility

- Please note that this position does not support a fully remote work arrangement
- Candidates should be prepared to relocate to Canton Ticino (Switzerland) or to Italian border areas close to Switzerland

- Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, including test design, automation, validation, and troubleshooting
- Practical experience using SQL for data verification and test setup
- Familiarity with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, etc.)
- Experience with Jira and Xray for test management
- Excellent command of Italian and English (spoken and written)
- ISTQB Certification or similar is a plus
- Hands-on experience with tools such as Tosca Tricentis in a plus

- Strong ownership mindset, proactive attitude, and willingness to actively contribute to day‑to‑day testing activities

We firmly believe in the value of cooperation and in the contribution that every idea and intuition can bring. We believe that everyone’s effort can make a difference. Transforming knowledge into a strategic resource is our company mission, and we pursue it with the help of our most strategic asset: our people We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Test Automation Engineer to ensure the quality, performance, and reliability of our software products. In this hands‑on role role , you will design, develop, and maintain backend automated tests written in Java , with a strong focus on robust API testing. You will also act as a reference point for quality and testing strategy, collaborating closely with developers and stakeholders to integrate testing practices into the development lifecycle and continuously enhance test coverage and efficiency. Key Responsibilities

- Act as fully hands‑on Test Automation for backend and API testing activities
- Design, implement, and maintain Java‑based automated test scripts for backend systems, with a strong emphasis on API testing
- Define and evolve the overall test automation strategy, frameworks, and best practices
- Contribute to test automation coverage of frontend systems when needed
- Translate technical and business requirements into effective and reusable test scenarios
- Execute automated test cases, analyze results, and report defects in a timely and detailed manner
- Investigate and troubleshoot failures and issues during test runs
- Ensure seamless integration of automated tests within CI/CD pipelines
- Coordinate testing activities, prioritize test efforts, and support continuous improvement of testing processes
- Define and implement quality control standards and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives
- Collaborate with the development team to understand application workflows and develop comprehensive test strategies

## Required Qualifications and Skills

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience
- 5+ years of hands‑on experience in backend test automation, with a proven track record in API testing
- In-depth experience with tools such as Postman, SoapUI, JMeter
- Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, including test design, automation, validation, and troubleshooting
- Practical experience using SQL for data verification and test setup
- Familiarity with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, etc.)
- Experience with Jira and Xray for test management
- Excellent command of Italian and English (spoken and written)
- ISTQB Certification or similar is a plus
- Hands-on experience with tools such as Tosca Tricentis in a plus
- Solid understanding of Agile methodologies and experience working in Scrum teams
- Strong ownership mindset, proactive attitude, and willingness to actively contribute to day‑to‑day testing activities

## Location Requirement

- Please note that a fully remote work policy is not offered for this role
- Candidates should be prepared to relocate to Canton Ticino/Switzerland or towns near the Swiss-Italian border
- Work-from-home days may be possible according to the Client's policy
